name: Valormok
summary: Valormok keeps a Horde foothold in northwest Azshara. North of the Haldarr Encampment, the outpost sends scouts and travelers toward the cursed ancient ruins along the coast.

sections.title: A Precarious Foothold
sections.body: Autumn-colored trees ring Valormok, where the Horde holds a foothold in a hostile and largely forsaken land. Nearby satyrs, nagas, and prowling beasts threaten the lightly fortified camp. Its warriors hold their ground despite the danger. Wind riders connect Valormok with Orgrimmar and the wilder reaches of northern Kalimdor.

sections.title: Treachery and Retribution
sections.body: Ag'tor Bloodfist leads Valormok's survivors after Magus Rimtori betrayed their escort. Belgrom Rockmaul sent Horde warriors with the blood elf to seek ancient treasures and powerful relics among the ruins. Rimtori turned on them and killed the warriors to claim the artifacts. Now the survivors plot vengeance against Rimtori and her cohort at the nearby Thalassian Base Camp.

faq.answer: Valormok is a remote Horde outpost in northwest Azshara. Its flight master connects travelers with routes across Kalimdor, and the camp supports those surveying the ancient coastal wilderness.
Ag'tor Bloodfist leads Valormok and maintains the Horde foothold there.

faq.q: Why were so many Horde warriors killed here?
faq.answer: Belgrom Rockmaul sent Horde warriors to escort Magus Rimtori as she searched for relics. Rimtori betrayed and killed them to claim the artifacts for herself.

faq.q: Where does the flight master connect to?
aliases: where can i fly from valormok
faq.answer: Valormok's wind rider master offers routes to Orgrimmar, Thunder Bluff, the Crossroads, Splintertree Post, Bloodvenom Post, and Everlook.

angles.text: As a Horde adventurer, you find a foothold at Valormok among Azshara's treacherous ruins, with flight connections and a call for vengeance.
As an orc stationed far from Orgrimmar, you face a grim test of endurance and bear the duty to avenge your betrayed kin.
